drafted_from: tools/grade-and-repair-speech-audio/tool-rows.json (tool:measure-speech-in-my-recordings), do-work/probe_speech.py and show_probe.py, read-data/measure.py, test/grade-and-repair-speech-audio.test.mjs (the probe test)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Measure how loud and noisy the speech in the spans of /Work/demo/spans.json is, without grading it, writing to /Work/demo/probe, so I can choose my settings." It runs tool:measure-speech-in-my-recordings on your computer and tells you each span's numbers.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads a spans file on your computer and writes cuts and probe.json into a folder you name.
instructions: 1. Install ffmpeg, numpy, scipy and soundfile; this tool needs no settings and no models.
2. Write a spans file ({"spans":[{"clip","source","from","to","text","words"}]}); word times make the noise floor come from the pauses between words.
3. Say "Measure the speech in my spans file". Your AI reads the row with tools:list and runs its run command with your spans file and a new output folder.
4. Read the one-line-per-span table and probe.json, then use the numbers to choose the settings tool:grade-and-repair-speech-audio will judge against.

worked_examples.title: Three synthetic recordings measured side by side
worked_examples.ask: Measure the speech in my three spans so I can choose what counts as good.
worked_examples.given: From tools/grade-and-repair-speech-audio/test/grade-and-repair-speech-audio.test.mjs (the probe test), run here for real on a spans file /Work/demo/spans.json with three spans of three synthetic recordings (clean.wav, noisy.wav with a 60 Hz hum and loud floor, clipped.wav driven into clipping), each from 0.4 to 5.0 s with its five word times, and one repeat of the first. The AI reads the row with this tools:list call, then runs: python3 trillion-workshop/tools/grade-and-repair-speech-audio/do-work/probe_speech.py --spans /Work/demo/spans.json --out /Work/demo/probe && python3 trillion-workshop/tools/grade-and-repair-speech-audio/do-work/show_probe.py /Work/demo/probe/probe.json. Paths shown for /Work/demo/probe.
worked_examples.hands_back: probe_speech.py prints each span's measures as JSON and then {"result": {"probe": "/Work/demo/probe/probe.json", "spans": 3}} (the repeat is measured once). show_probe.py prints three lines: "clean_0.40_5.00 dur 4.6 lufs -15.6 tp -4.8 nf -80.2 snr 66.4 clip0.0000 hum 0.0@0 lf-104.1/0.00 tail-40.0 word", "noisy_0.40_5.00 dur 4.6 lufs -15.8 tp -4.0 nf -32.3 snr 18.6 clip0.0000 hum 15.4@100 lf -33.9/0.69 tail-26.8 word" and "clipped_0.40_5.00 dur 4.6 lufs -5.2 tp 0.2 nf -64.7 snr 61.8 clip0.2200 hum 5.0@120 lf -88.7/0.00 tail-40.0 word" (columns padded as printed). The cut is exactly from..to (duration 4.6), with no handle.
